newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat vs mark, eases on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat vs mark, eases on dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 994-996 per mark, in a little wider spread from the opening's 994.50-996 as interbank market activity slowed down in the afternoon, dealers said.
* Spot dollar gained to 1,836-1,839 levs from the morning's 1,829-1,833, tracking a firmer dollar/mark on global markets.

* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark from July 1 under the currency board, a form of a restrictive fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to curb inflation and restore confidence in the lev.
* Under the IMF-prescribed currency board the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of the anchor currency at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
